title: Claim Unit Cap for FBN Warehouse-Loss Claims
content:
The claim unit cap on the claimable lost units of a Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) warehouse-loss case is the large-program claim unit cap of 60 units for an enrollment in FBN Scale Program, FBN Premier Program or FBN Enterprise Program active at least the claim-cap tenure of 12 whole months since its activation date, and the mid-program claim unit cap of 30 units for an enrollment in FBN Core Program or FBN Growth Program active at least that tenure of 12 whole months. An enrollment meeting neither description receives no higher cap under this clause.

## Program and tenure together

| Enrollment's program on the handling date | Whole months since activation | Claim unit cap under this clause |
|---|---|---|
| FBN Scale, Premier or Enterprise Program | 12 or more | 60 units |
| FBN Scale, Premier or Enterprise Program | 11 or fewer | no higher cap |
| FBN Core or Growth Program | 12 or more | 30 units |
| FBN Core or Growth Program | 11 or fewer | no higher cap |
| FBN Starter Program | any | no higher cap |

Whole months run from the activation date to the handling date, a whole month passing on the same day number of a later month.

Boundary example (hypothetical): an FBN Growth Program enrollment activated on 8 June reaches 12 whole months on 8 June of the next year; on that day its cap is 30 units, and on 7 June it is not yet.
